<http://www.example.org/ontology/theatre-productions> a owl:Ontology ;
    rdfs:label "Theatre Productions Ontology" ;
    rdfs:comment "Ontology for modelling theatre productions, festivals, plays, actors, and related events in Italy." .

### Classes

:Author a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Author" ; rdfs:comment "A person who writes plays." .
:City a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "City" ; rdfs:comment "A city where festivals or theatres are located." .
:Country a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Country" ; rdfs:comment "A country in which a city is located." .
:Ensemble a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Ensemble" ; rdfs:comment "A group of actors performing together in a production." .
:Play a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Play" ; rdfs:comment "A written dramatic work performed in a production." .
:Production a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Production" ; rdfs:comment "A specific staging of a play at a theatre." .
:Newspaper a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Newspaper" ; rdfs:comment "A publisher of reviews." .
:Theatre a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Theatre" ; rdfs:comment "A venue for theatre productions." .
:TheatreFestival a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Theatre Festival" ; rdfs:comment "An event hosting multiple theatre productions." .
:Act a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Act" ; rdfs:comment "A major division of a play." .
:ProductionPremiere a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Production Premiere" ; rdfs:comment "The first performance of a production." .
:ProductionParticipation a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Production Participation" ; rdfs:comment "Reifies the participation of a theatre in a production, with date." .
:RoleAssignment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Role Assignment" ; rdfs:comment "Reifies the assignment of a role to an actor in a production at a specific time." .
:EnsembleMembership a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Ensemble Membership" ; rdfs:comment "Reifies the membership of an actor in an ensemble, with time interval." .
:ProductionReview a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Production Review" ; rdfs:comment "Reifies the review of a production by a newspaper, with star rating." .
:ActorEmployment a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Actor Employment" ; rdfs:comment "Reifies the employment of an actor at a theatre, with start date." .
:Role a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "Role" ; rdfs:comment "A role played by an actor in a production." .

### Disjointness and Union
:City owl:disjointWith :Country .
:Actor owl:disjointWith :Ensemble .
:TheatreFestival owl:disjointWith :Production .
:Play owl:disjointWith :Production .
:Role owl:disjointWith :Actor .
:ProductionParticipation owl:disjointWith :RoleAssignment, :EnsembleMembership .
:RoleAssignment owl:disjointWith :EnsembleMembership .
